Accept exact Drying Basin recipes with optional exact item and/or sized fluid inputs, exact item and/or sized fluid outputs, and positive recipe duration as station work. When an item output exists it is the primary; otherwise the fluid output is primary. Reject non-simple ingredients, tag-derived ItemStackFromIngredient outputs, empty plans, and non-positive duration.

Accept exact Mechanical Drying Basin recipes under the same item/fluid determinism rules as Drying Basin, with recipe duration as station work and loaded BlockMechanicalDryingBasinConfig.consumptionRate * duration NeoForge Energy. When an item output exists it is the primary; otherwise the fluid output is primary.

Accept Mechanical Squeezer recipes only when the input ingredient is simple/exact, every item output chance is exactly 1.0F, optional fluid output is exact, duration is positive, and loaded BlockMechanicalSqueezerConfig.consumptionRate * duration is a finite positive FE total. The first guaranteed item is primary; additional guaranteed items and fluid are remainders. Chance outputs below 1.0 fail closed. Manual Squeezer remains rejected.
